facts.fact: NOSi's 2024 plan forecasts CVE 333,345,000 of revenue from protocols with the State, money the document says the buying ministries pay NOSi, the state digital agency, in budget year 2024.

systems.country_label: Núcleo Operacional da Sociedade de Informação

note: Projetos Financiados CVE 269,638,000 is donor money (World Bank Digital Cabo Verde credit) and gives no fact; the plan is the agency's own, so the state-paid amount is the protocols line only.
